title: Godot C# Saveable
key_points: A save system for Godot C#
Uses Newtonsoft.Json for serialization and deserialization
Supports encrypted, compressed, and regular modes
ISaveable interface to allow modular save/load structures
limitations: Depends on the Mono version of Godot (4.2.x)
Limited documentation available for some features
asserts: The source provides a save system for Godot C# projects using JSON format, supporting encrypted, compressed, and regular saves with an ISaveable interface.
scope: The scope is the functionality and integration of this plugin into Godot C# projects for saving node trees and custom classes.
